CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2625 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c. Bus nonce: d7b9da0aaa204d1fe6601a439354e76d. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c` or `Fix review: blocked 960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: d7b9da0aaa204d1fe6601a439354e76d`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2625 960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2625-d7b9da0a`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, round 2, PR #2625 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), group R10-RCA-BODY-LINT (RP, policy, sonnet). Head 960135738416bf6b23cc6552923c392ca9cedc2c (r2 0bcc7d4e plus a merge of main). Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head; finder harness per the group brief, never the fixer harness. Re-read the head first; a moved head is blocked.

Check:
1. Round 1's block is resolved: its carry-missing/RCA demonstration finding is answered in the body and by the r2 diff (null control plus planted defect caught).
2. The two R10-FLOW-JIDOKA carries are on the roster at a46a37a8 and 5ba47bff as named in the PR body. Read: git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json
3. The diff does not touch dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD).
4. CI at the head: read check-runs; a red nightly-status is not this PR unless its diff reaches what it reads.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
